metadata.title: U.S. stocks set to decline following fresh highs - MarketWatch

content.text:
June 2, 3:44am ET
U.S. stocks set to decline following fresh highs
How stock-index futures are trading:
S&P 500 futures are down 0.1%.
Dow Jones Industrial Average futures are down 0.2%.
Nasdaq 100 futures are down 0.1%.
U.S. stocks are set to move lower after reaching record highs at the close on Monday driven by optimism over artificial intelligence.
